headline: Soccer should learn from the NFL to fix the mess that VAR has created
description: Is it time to give the VAR the red card, or does soccer actually need the red flag? The Manchester derby controversy could have been avoided with an on-field challenge.

headline: VAR right not to send off Arsenal's Gabriel for Emi Martínez kick, panel finds
description: The referee and VAR were correct not to issue a red card to Arsenal defender Gabriel for his kick to the head of Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez earlier this month, a panel has found.

headline: Big-spending Tottenham get £120m boost from owners - reports

headline: Cole Palmer temporarily suspended from Twitch after streaming EA FC 27 early: 'Unban me pls'
